Table of detections and recording effort per site, time bin and species

Source: R/07_detection_table.R
pam_detection_table.Rd

The shared starting point for activity patterns, richness and abundance indices. It counts the cleaned detections (Stage 4) of every species in every site and time bin, and puts the recording effort next to the counts, so rates per recorded hour can be compared between sites that were recorded for different lengths of time.

Usage

pam_detection_table(
  cfg,
  run_id = cfg$birdnet$run_id,
  bin_days = NULL,
  thresholds = NULL,
  min_effort_hours = NULL,
  extra_by = character(),
  complete = TRUE,
  write = FALSE
)

Arguments

cfg

A pam_config object.

run_id

Detection run (sub-folder of paths$detections).

bin_days

Length of a time bin in days. NULL (the default) uses occupancy$occasion_length_days from the config (1 if not set); use 7 for weekly bins.

thresholds

Optional per-species thresholds: a data frame, or the path of a CSV file, with scientific_name and threshold (for example the result of pam_species_thresholds()). They are applied to the event confidence on top of Stage 4, so they can only remove more events. To keep events below the Stage 4 cut-off, lower it there and run Stage 4 again.

min_effort_hours

Minimum recorded hours for a bin to count as surveyed. NULL uses occupancy$min_effort_hours (2 if not set).

extra_by

Optional names of further detection columns to count by, for example a call type, if your detections have one.

complete

If TRUE (the default), every surveyed site and bin gets a row for every species, with 0 where it was not detected. Set to FALSE for very large projects to keep only rows with detections.

write

If TRUE, also save the table as <outputs>/<run_id>/detection_table.csv. Nothing is written by default.

Value

A data.table with one row per site, bin and species (and extra_by column): site_id, bin_start, bin_end, species, scientific_name, n_detections (events), n_files (recordings with a detection), max_confidence, effort_hours, n_days, sufficient (the bin reached the minimum effort) and detections_per_hour. Bins below the minimum effort are kept and flagged, not dropped. The bin length and first bin day are stored in the attributes bin_days and origin.

Details

Sites and effort

Sites follow the occupancy stage: the grid name, or grid_deploymentId for grids with several deployments. Effort counts recordings that passed QC and lie inside a deployment window. Detections that fall in a site and bin with no effort (for example, in a recording that failed QC) are dropped with a warning.

Time bins

All bins start on the first day with any recording in the project, so a bin covers the same dates at every site.

Examples

ex <- pam_example_project()
# the later stages read the master table that the scan builds
res <- suppressMessages(pam_scan_audio(ex$cfg))
proc <- suppressMessages(pam_process_detections(ex$cfg))
tab <- suppressMessages(pam_detection_table(ex$cfg))
as.data.frame(tab)[, c("site_id", "bin_start", "species", "n_detections", "effort_hours")]
#>   site_id  bin_start                                    species n_detections
#> 1   G0059 2026-04-05  Ducula nicobarica_Nicobar Imperial-Pigeon            2
#> 2   G0059 2026-04-05         Gracula religiosa_Common Hill Myna            0
#> 3   G0059 2026-04-05 Psittacula longicauda_Long-tailed Parakeet            3
#> 4   G0110 2026-04-06  Ducula nicobarica_Nicobar Imperial-Pigeon            2
#> 5   G0110 2026-04-06         Gracula religiosa_Common Hill Myna            1
#> 6   G0110 2026-04-06 Psittacula longicauda_Long-tailed Parakeet            2
#>   effort_hours
#> 1  0.001666667
#> 2  0.001666667
#> 3  0.001666667
#> 4  0.001666667
#> 5  0.001666667
#> 6  0.001666667
# two-day bins instead of one-day bins
tab2 <- suppressMessages(pam_detection_table(ex$cfg, bin_days = 2))
unique(tab2$bin_start)
#> [1] "2026-04-05"
